Events.Title: Hollows at the Bus Stop
Events.Callout: Screams from a bus stop. Hollows are circling the people waiting for the night bus.
Events.Objective: Save the people at the bus stop
Events.Success: The night bus pulls up to a very grateful queue.
Events.Failure: Nobody at that bus stop is waiting for the bus anymore.

Events.Title: Crashed Courier
Events.Callout: A courier van went into a pole. The parcels are still inside, and Neon Jackals are sniffing at the blood.
Events.Objective: Clear the jackals, then take the parcels
Events.Success: The parcels are yours. The courier's insurance company will never know.

Events.Title: Preacher of the Third Eye
Events.Callout: A street preacher on a crate is shouting about the Third Eye. He seems to know a lot about yours.
Events.Name: Deacon Ferro

Lines.Speaker: Deacon Ferro
Lines.Text: Brothers! Sisters! Delivery drivers! The Eye is open, and it sees your parking tickets!

Lines.Speaker: Deacon Ferro
Lines.Text: You. Yes, you, glowing one. The Veil is thin tonight. Walk where the light bends and come back with your shadow. Not everybody does.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Do you say that to everyone?

Lines.Speaker: Deacon Ferro
Lines.Text: Only to the ones who can hear the static. Here. Take a blessing. It's mostly Lumen.

Events.Title: Recruitment Brawl
Events.Callout: Ember Court and Brass Tower Union recruiters are settling who signs the new kids. With fists.
Events.Success: Your side won the recruiting drive. Three new members, two black eyes.

Events.Title: Mites in the Parking Lot
Events.Callout: A rogue Glass Mite swarm is chewing the paint off every car in a parking lot.
Events.Success: The swarm is dust. The car owners will still blame the valet.

Events.Title: Rift Incursion
Events.Callout: The air over a plaza tore open like wet paper. Things are climbing out of the Inner World.
Events.Objective: Close the rift: break its crystal heart
Events.Success: The rift folds shut and the plaza smells of ozone and burnt sugar.

Events.Title: The Wrong Neighbour
Events.Callout: Someone on this block came home twice tonight. One of them is a Mirror Wraith.
Events.Objective: Open the Third Eye near the crowd to find the wraith
Events.Success: The wraith shatters. The real neighbour never finds out, and that is a mercy.

Events.Title: Static Saints Jammer
Events.Callout: The Static Saints bolted a signal jammer to a lamp post. Every radio on the block is preaching their sermons.
Events.Objective: Wreck the jammer or pull its wires
Events.Success: The jammer dies. Somewhere, a radio plays an ordinary song again.

Events.Title: Canal Choir Smugglers
Events.Callout: Singing on the water. A Canal Choir boat is unloading crates on the embankment, and nobody is paying the toll.
Events.Success: Three crates lighter, the Choir sings a very sad song.

Events.Title: Jackals in the Park
Events.Callout: A pack of Neon Jackals has two night joggers cornered in the park.
Events.Success: The joggers are fine. They will never jog at night again.

Events.Title: Shades Over the Graves
Events.Callout: Hollow Shades are drifting over Grave Frequency Cemetery. The headstones are humming.
Events.Success: The cemetery goes back to the ordinary kind of quiet.

Events.Title: Golem in the Lot
Events.Callout: A pile of cut shard on a building lot just stood up. The night crew is hiding behind the scaffolding.
Events.Success: The golem is gravel again. The crew asks if you do weddings.

Events.Title: A Lost Echo
Events.Callout: Someone is standing very still under a street light, glowing faintly. Nobody else seems to see them.
Events.Name: Someone's Echo

Lines.Speaker: Someone's Echo
Lines.Text: I was waiting for somebody. I think it was a long time ago. Is it still Thursday?

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: It's been a lot of Thursdays.

Lines.Speaker: Someone's Echo
Lines.Text: Oh. Then I can stop waiting. Thank you for telling me. Here, I won't need this light anymore.

Events.Title: Mender Under Siege
Events.Callout: A Mender's street stall is under attack. Hollows want the patients, and the Mender wants a minute.
Events.Success: The Mender patches up the last patient and nods at you like you work there.
Events.Failure: The stall is empty. The Menders will hear about this.

Events.Title: Falling Crystal
Events.Callout: A crystal shard just fell out of the sky and stuck in the street. Roof Oni racers are already on their way.
Events.Objective: Grab the crystal before the Oni do
Events.Success: The shard is yours. It is warm and it hums when you are not looking.
Events.Failure: The Roof Oni got there first.

Events.Title: Lotus Payroll Van
Events.Callout: A Mirage Lotus payroll van broke down on the Strip. The guards are arguing about who has to push.
Events.Success: Payday came early. It just wasn't yours. Now it is.

Events.Title: Courthouse Scuffle
Events.Callout: Glass Jury fixers and Quartz Kings bikers are disagreeing about a verdict. Loudly. With chairs.

Events.Title: Rivals on the Embankment
Events.Callout: Roof Oni racers came down off the skyrail to pick a fight with the Canal Choir. Somebody is going in the water.
Events.Success: Your side kept the embankment. The other side is drying off.

Events.Title: Lanterns Out on the Row
Events.Callout: The Canal Choir's lantern shrine went dark, and Hollow Shades are gathering where the light used to be.
Events.Success: The lanterns burn again. Somewhere on the water, the Choir starts singing.
Events.Failure: The lanterns stayed dark. The shades stayed too.

Events.Title: The Fortune Teller
Events.Callout: A fortune teller has set up a stall on the corner. Her crystal ball is a little too bright.
Events.Name: Madame Orrery

Lines.Speaker: Madame Orrery
Lines.Text: Sit, sit. I see... a tall stranger. A long journey. A glowing rock. Oh, that one's just you.

Lines.Speaker: Madame Orrery
Lines.Text: I see a queen made of glass, a giant made of ice, and a man who never sleeps enough. That's free. The rest costs extra.

Lines.Speaker: Madame Orrery
Lines.Text: That you'll tip well. Look at that. I'm never wrong.

Events.Title: Night Market Panic
Events.Callout: Hollows are pouring out of an alley into a night market. The noodle vendor refuses to leave his wok.
Events.Success: The market reopens five minutes later. The noodles are on the house.
Events.Failure: The market is empty except for an abandoned wok.
